committee_summary: H.R. 4190, the ``Restoring Benefits to Defrauded Veterans Act,'' was introduced by Rep. David J. Trone of Maryland on June 15, 2023. The bill, as amended, would prohibit the Secretary of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) from repaying a deceased beneficiary's misused benefits to a fiduciary who misused the beneficiary's benefits. Further, if a beneficiary whose benefits were misused predeceases repayment of such misused benefits, the bill would require VA to pay such misused benefits to an individual or individuals first on the list provided in Title 38 U.S.C. Sec. 5121: the veteran's spouse, the veteran's children (in equal shares), the veteran's dependent parents (in equal shares), etc.
